name: Traduction des sous-titres
description: Translates a caption track offline, French to English or English to French, into a second caption track with the same timings (Opus-MT tc-big running on the CPU; nothing leaves the computer). The model is a one-time download of about 460 MB per direction (CC-BY-4.0, source and licence shown before): transcript.downloadModel {model:opus-mt-tc-big-fr-en} or opus-mt-tc-big-en-fr, or the Speech models settings. About a second per caption.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Traduire en anglais (FR → EN)
entries.description: Translate the first caption track from French to English into a new track.

entries.label: Traduire en français (EN → FR)
entries.description: Translate the first caption track from English to French into a new track.

entries.label: Transcrire, sous-titrer et traduire en anglais
entries.description: French speech: transcribe, caption (42 characters, 2 lines), translate to English as a second track.

entries.label: Transcrire, sous-titrer et traduire en français
entries.description: English speech: transcribe, caption, translate to French as a second track.

entries.label: Exporter la piste traduite en .srt
entries.description: Write the second caption track (the translation) to <project>.<lang>.srt.
